title: kbmon's shared snapshot is one per checkout, not one per clone as its goal says, and the pane's receipt and needs-you runs stay unshared
goal: kbmon's shared snapshot lives once per clone, in the main checkout's _cache (found through the git common directory), not once per checkout; kb/_self/monitoring.md names the pane's --receipt and --status all runs as per-pane and unshared

run: import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile; R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); M = os.path.join(T, "main"); W = os.path.join(T, "wt"); os.makedirs(M); env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_")}; sh = lambda *a: subprocess.run(a, cwd=M, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120); sh("git", "init", "-q", "."); sh("git", "-c", "user.email=a@example.com", "-c", "user.name=n", "commit", "-q", "--allow-empty", "-m", "i"); sh("git", "worktree", "add", "-q", "-b", "w", W); p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "kbmon.py"), "--root", W, "--once", "--shared", "--max-age", "0", "--panel", "host"], cwd=T, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120); ok = os.path.exists(os.path.join(M, "_cache", "kbmon", "shared.json")); print("exit", p.returncode, "snapshot in the main checkout:", ok, "in the worktree:", os.path.exists(os.path.join(W, "_cache", "kbmon", "shared.json"))); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys; t = open("kb/_self/monitoring.md", encoding="utf-8").read(); ok = any("--receipt" in p and "--status all" in p and "per-pane" in p for p in t.split("\n\n")); print("monitoring.md names --receipt and --status all as per-pane" if ok else "monitoring.md does not name the --receipt and --status all runs as per-pane"); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Where does kbmon keep the shared snapshot when git cannot name a main checkout (no git, a bare clone, a common directory not named .git)?
gates.reason: the pane still works and the snapshot is shared among sessions of that one checkout

notes: Review gap 4 of SP-wpttdu7u: kbmon.py:93 and shared() use a.root.resolve()/_cache/kbmon/shared.json; register.tsx lines 111 and 166 run --receipt and notifyNeeds runs --status all per pane.
